title: Great bike tour of Barcelona
text: Very comprehensive bike tour of Barcelona!  Our guide Kym was excellent, providing tons of information about the city!  We recommend this tour.
author: tomcB4105XV

title: The perfect way to start exploring Barcelona!
text: We had an amazing bike tour with our German-speaking guide!  Everything was fantastic, and we especially loved how passionate and enthusiastic he was about showing us Barcelona and sharing his knowledge of Spain. You can really tell how much he loves what he does! We enjoyed every minute and would definitely recommend him to others!
author: E9624NHdariap

title: Great Tour
text: Really grreat organised bike tour with a very knowledgeable guide ( Kim ) , good value for money to see the sites and hear the history of Barcelona 👍🏼
author: Richard_H

title: Would easily book again!
text: Very happy with our reintroduction to Barcelona. Great guide {Kim} carefully took us through the neighborhoods and gave us great insight. On time, and very courteous.
author: George_S

title: Fantastic!
text: Fantastic tour with Chris! He was so much fun and very knowledgeable. The three hours went by very quickly and it didn’t even bother me that it rained the last hour of the tour. Highly recommend this activity!
author: katjamR3026XS

title: This was a really great...
text: This was a really great tour! Riding the bikes around  town is one of the best ways to get acclimated and our stops helped us better understand historical importance of our surroundings. I would highly recommend this tour.
author: michelle_z

title: Best of Barca
text: Igor was absolutely fantastic - his knowledge of the city and local life exceeded our expectations of the tour. He gave us a lot of suggestions of where to eat as well as hidden gems in the city. We loved the tour - bikes were comfortable and easy to ride. Streets were easy to navigate and we had time to stop for pictures and questions. 100/10 would absolutely do it again!
author: zoemW2926WT

title: Very nice tour, great way to see the city
text: Very nice tour and a wonderful guide.  His directions were easy to follow as we navigated the city.  He was very safety conscious which was much appreciated.  Don’t let the first glance of the bikes fool you, they work wonderfully, are well maintained and easy to operate.
author: Brent_L

title: Compact tour with excellent historical facts and beautiful buildings.  Would recommend Tomas as a guide!
text: Tomas cleverly wove a great story about the history of Barcelona as we stopped at the various sights on the bike tour.  The bikes had good brakes which was useful as it rained in the first 1.5hrs of the 3hrs tour.  They have plenty of helmets to choose from.  Speeds were kept down and you had to pump the brakes with both hands for safety in the rain.  Nearly all flat, the 7.5 mile route took us past breathtaking historic buildings and it was such fun riding through the Gothic Quarter (although you had to be very careful of pedestrians). title: A WOW EXPERIENCE
text: What an experience!!!  Our guide Adrian was fantastic!! He provied us with so much information and so many stories that really upgraded this experience for my wife and I!!  We were able to actually experience the spiritual moment of being up close to the Black Madonna-Barcelona Y was able to arrange this for us!! All in all it was a once in a life time experience due to our guide ADRIAN!!!!
